case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_functional_mean_band; native etr_plot_functional_mean_band(...,strict_source_record=TRUE) is a deliberately bounded source-geometry port.
Native etr_functional_mean_band with dimension-labelled complete same-grid mean/lower/upper arrays and confidence in (0,1); strict mode uses first source dimension when omitted.

Source fill_between x=time, lower/upper exactly original uncertainty bounds, alpha 0.2, percent confidence label formatted to one decimal; mean original line and source legend. Direct frozen Python Matplotlib PolyCollection/Line2D artist comparisons committed.
Missing dimension, nonfinite or inverted uncertainty bounds, invalid confidence level, class/domain mismatch and nonlogical strict mode fail closed; Python exception identity excluded.
Native one-panel typed scientific fill band and mean line data; not a Python Matplotlib Axes object, not color/pixel equivalent.
Simultaneously calibrated observed-grid functional mean confidence band and original center line for one named dimension; no recalibration.
